messages:
jordan-customer: Hey team — our Feb invoice (inv_2026_02_28_81) is $1.2k higher than the dashboard total. Dashboard shows $3.4k, invoice is $4.6k. Account: acct_9X7. Can someone explain the delta?

maya-cs: Sorry for the trouble, Jordan. Can you confirm if there were any plan changes or reserved capacity toggles in Feb? I'll loop in billing/usage.

jordan-customer: We downgraded from Growth -> Starter on 2026-02-20. We did enable a short burst of reserved capacity Feb 25–27 for a demo, but dashboard showed a small proration credit on the 20th.

maya-cs: copying @liam-billing and @alex-engineer to pull ledger + meter logs.

liam-billing: Thanks — two quick checks: (1) is the invoice showing any 'reserved capacity' or 'dedicated hours' lines? (2) did you see any credits in the account ledger around 2/20?

jordan-customer: invoice lines: ```
Line 1: Plan Starter (prorated) -$180.00
Line 2: Text Generation usage - $2,980.21
Line 3: Embedding usage - $1,150.33
Line 4: Reserved Capacity (hours) - $820.00
Subtotal: $4,770.54
Tax: -$170.54
Total: $4,600.00
```
Dashboard shows totals by category: Text $2,900, Embeddings $500, Plan charges $3,400 (includes proration). So embeddings on the invoice are way higher than dashboard.

alex-engineer: Thanks for the snippets. Please run this diagnostic and paste output: ```
rwd-usage-cli --account acct_9X7 --start 2026-02-01 --end 2026-02-28 --group-by meter_type --format json
```
That'll help confirm raw meter counts vs dashboard aggregates.

jordan-customer: ran it, output (trimmed): ```
{"text_gen_tokens": 1203456789, "embedding_tokens": 300123456, "dashboard_text_tokens": 1000123456, "dashboard_embedding_tokens": 50012345}
```

sophie-usage: :eyes: I think I see the pattern — embedding_tokens in the raw meter (300M) vs dashboard (50M) indicates the dashboard view is applying a post-aggregation filter or an old sampling window. More importantly: we rolled out embed_v2 pipeline on 2026-02-18 that temporarily wrote meter events to both the new and legacy ingestion streams if customers had burst/reserved flags set. That can double-count embeddings in billing.

alex-engineer: Confirming Sophie — I can see duplicated embedding event batches in the billing topic for that account between 2026-02-18 and 2026-02-27. Separate issue: the dashboard's default view excludes 'reserved capacity' billed hours unless you toggle the "show infra charges" filter, so customers often miss that line. That explains reserved capacity showing up on invoice but not in the quick dashboard totals.

maya-cs: So combo of (A) mid-month plan downgrade/proration, (B) duplicate embedding meter events from embed_v2 fallback, and (C) reserved capacity hours shown on invoice but hidden in default dashboard.

liam-billing: Root cause summary looks right. Action plan: (1) finance will issue a credit for duplicated embedding usage and reissue corrected invoice; (2) engineering will dedupe historical duplicated meter events for affected accounts and push a fix to the embed pipeline; (3) CS will add a UI hint so dashboard shows infra/reserved lines by default during month-end.

liam-billing: I'll queue a credit for $1,200 against inv_2026_02_28_81 to offset the double-count and reissue the corrected invoice tomorrow EOD. Tagging finance-bot to create the ledger entry.

finance-bot: Created credit cr_2026_03_01_11 for acct_9X7 amount $1,200, pending invoice reissue.

alex-engineer: Deployed safe fix to the embed ingestion (2026-03-01 14:32 UTC) to stop duplicate writes. We'll run a dedupe job for Feb 18–27; ETA for dedupe completion: 2026-03-02 23:59 UTC.

jordan-customer: Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear explanation. Will watch for the corrected invoice.

maya-cs: Following up after invoice reissue to confirm totals match dashboard after dedupe. Leaving this thread open until the corrected invoice is in your portal. :white_check_mark:

jordan-customer: Sounds good, thank you! :raised_hands:
